blurb: Davis Park Golf Course is an 18-hole public golf course open from March 1st through November 15th, featuring a driving range, putting and chipping greens, and a practice bunker. The course has a pro shop, cafe, and offers golf lessons. It operates dawn to dusk and has a history dating back to 1964.
